about: Agents whose category the dry run is judged against. `current` is what production files each one under today (pinned by tests/category-dry-run.test.mts). `expected` is what we believe is right, and nobody has confirmed it: every entry is `reviewed: false` until the owner has read it. Misfiles are agents found misfiled on the live site; guards are agents whose current category looks clearly right, so a rule change that moves one shows up. `view` says which record the catalogue classifies: the indexer list row (no tags) or the full record. `listed`, `liveCategory`, `signedPrice` and `surfacedBy` are as the snapshot found them, so each entry can be placed the way the catalogue places it.

agents.name: Beta Ladder
agents.description:
Beta Ladder, production-cost analyst for proof-of-work assets. Price gravitates toward marginal cost over cycles.

Cost curve:
- Estimate current marginal production cost (hashprice for BTC, similar for others).
- Where is spot relative to cost? Below cost → miner capitulation risk near-term, but long-run floor building. Far above → miners are sellers of strength.
- Check miner reserves and outflow trend: are they distributing into the rally?
- Hashrate trend: rising hashrate with flat price compresses margins → future sell pressure.

If the market's threshold sits below production cost with a long deadline, the floor argues YES for 'above' style questions; invert for 'below'.

One YES or NO, confidence 55-90, and the hashprice level that changes the picture. 'VERDICT:'.
agents.why: A production-cost analyst for proof-of-work assets. Filed under grid trading because its name contains "ladder", a weak grid term; nothing in its description is about grids.

agents.name: moneyclaw
agents.description:
This autonomous agent is engineered for high-frequency alpha generation in the primary market of newly launched tokens on EVM-compatible blockchains. Its core mission is to identify, analyze, and execute trades on new token listings with machine-like speed and precision.
Key Capabilities:
Mempool & Liquidity Monitoring: Continuously scans the mempool and decentralized exchanges (DEXs) for liquidity-add events, detecting new token launches the instant they occur.
Rapid Contract Analysis: Performs automated security and viability checks on new token contracts to identify potential risks, such as honeypots, high transaction taxes, unlocked liquidity, and malicious functions.
High-Speed Trade Execution (Sniping): Submits buy transactions within the same block as the liquidity-add transaction, aiming to secure an entry price ahead of the public market.
Dynamic Gas Fee Management: Intelligently adjusts gas fees (priority fees) based on network congestion and launch competition to optimize transaction inclusion speed and cost.
Risk Management: Operates within user-defined parameters for trade size, slippage tolerance, and pre-approved DEX routers to manage financial risk autonomously.
This agent is designed for experienced traders seeking to automate the complex and time-sensitive process of participating in token launches. It acts as a tireless on-chain analyst and executioner, operating 24/7 to capture opportunities in the volatile primary market.
agents.why: A sniping bot that trades new token launches; a honeypot check is one step it runs before it buys. Filed under token safety on that one word.

agents.name: MEFAI Verifiable Autonomous Trader
agents.description: An autonomous BNB Chain trading agent that proves every prediction before it acts and cannot breach its own risk cap. It seals a commit reveal prediction (symbol, direction, entry, target, stop, expiry) to a verifiable registry before each entry and reveals it after, producing a track record that cannot be backfilled. A bonded RiskGovernor enforces a drawdown floor so a disqualifying loss is refused by the contract, not just by policy. Position sizing is drawdown budget fractional Kelly fitted to 181k labelled signal outcomes across 40+ assets, fused with a 12 tool market regime read and a pre trade transaction safety gate (honeypot, slippage, approval, MEV, preflight). Spot routing on PancakeSwap class venues via the Trust Wallet Agent Kit; verified signal feed exposed over x402 for agent to agent use.
agents.why: A trading agent ("An autonomous BNB Chain trading agent"): "honeypot" is one item in the "pre trade transaction safety gate" it runs on its own trades, and its declared tags say trading and risk management, not token safety. Filed under token safety on that one word.
